data.meta_observations: The abstracts consistently focus on Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) as a core concept, with frequent mentions of the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and Agenda 2030. Many studies are case-specific, reporting on institutional experiences, pedagogical experiments, or curriculum reforms without quantitative data. Themes emerge around institutional strategies, teaching methods, competence development, and interdisciplinary approaches, reflecting a holistic view of sustainability in higher education.
data.grounding_notes: Evidence is limited to explicit statements from abstracts; quality notes indicate missing elements like objectives, methods, results, or conclusions in some abstracts, but this does not affect theme extraction. Some quotes contain encoding errors (e.g., â€œ) as per the provided text. Frequency judgments are based on the number of articles in this batch that explicitly mention the theme, with 'High' for >6 articles, 'Medium' for 3-6, and 'Low' for <3, though this is approximate. Confidence is high for well-supported themes, but lower for those with fewer references.
